subject: Shiny not working behind Corp Proxy (Microsoft WAP / NGINX)

messages.author: 2fdfbcc68bda7abb
messages.subject: Shiny not working behind Corp Proxy (Microsoft WAP / NGINX)
parts:
Shiny Open Source server behind Microsoft WAP (Corp Proxy) and NGINX (ProxyPass) is not working when connected through Internet i.e. https. The same setup is working when it's within Intranet i.e. no MS WAP layer. 

NGINX Setup

location / {
proxy_pass http://websocket;
proxy_http_version 1.1;
proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
proxy_set_header Connection $connection_upgrade;
}

When connected from Intranet the message that I am seeing in Firefox console is as follows

GET https://domain.com/test/__sockjs__/n=L1Oe71tDRDug51MNy5/info 200 OK 53ms sockjs-....min.js (line 27)
